phaseA.derivedSeedRule: after the root index is admitted, read only the README index named for each declared pillar root; use Git tree metadata, not bodies, to enumerate baseline openspec/specs/*/spec.md paths and top-level roster/*/butler.toml candidates
phaseA.output: revision-bound source manifest with extraction classes and sha256 digest

phaseB.manifestRule: manifest must validate against the signed PWB source grammar; it is derived data, not a separate owner-approved artifact

sourceAdmission.pathRuleScope: apply basename and prefix rules to the final segment, and suffix rules to the complete final segment, of each normalized repository-relative path

classificationOrder: verify exact Git-object membership in the phase-A seed algorithm or the phase-B revision-bound manifest against the signed PWB grammar
reject denied path or unsupported encoding
run every detector over transient bytes before parsing
parse only the closed extraction class assigned by the manifest
exclude the whole artifact on any match, NUL byte, strict UTF-8 failure, unknown extraction class, parse failure or resource-limit failure
classificationSuccess: a body is classifiable only when its normalized path is admitted by its current discovery phase, it decodes as strict UTF-8 without NUL, no detector matches, its extraction class is in the signed PWB closed set, and that extractor completes within declared limits
